<!-- pr-reviewer: b0a046a9e13bdce9ddbf836e138d54ebe65355ad -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for moving this over from #429. Reviewed at head b0a046a9, trial-merged with current `upstream/main` (5fd2b93a).

**What looks good**
- The trial merge is clean. There are no conflicts and no semantic clash with the per-setup mounts (#471), because the code only uses `setup_align::alignment`/`compose`/`inverse` and `setup::active`. Those functions are unchanged on main.
- The change is small, with no new dependencies and no `build.rs`, scripts or `.github` edits. The only shader edit is one `case 4` arm in `fs_stock`.
- Prime Directive: there is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` on the new paths. A bad sheet index is skipped, an empty body or sheet is refused by name, and a failed measurement is logged once and draws nothing.
- The preview is view-only state that follows the open page and is never undoable, which fits the command law. No components were added, and the layering is ui -> app.
- Measurement is keyed by (setup, active setup, `doc_version`), so the program sim does not run per frame. The page's box and volume reuse that measurement.
- New modules carry provenance lines. All files are well under 400 lines. The decision file is in `docs/decisions/`. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #406`, and `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched.
- The contributor's hands-on GUI check passed. I did not run the GUI.

**Local results (merged with main, debug, macOS)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `setup_stock_view` | 2 passed |
| app `setup_stock_source` (nearby suite) | 6 passed |
| ui `--lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 378 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The ui lib failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. It fails only because this machine has no GPU adapter, which the PR body also lists as a known headless red:
```
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found; ... metal had no fallback adapters ...
```
The new `incoming_view_tests` pass.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The z-fighting speckle on the teal top face, where it is coplanar with the setup's own Stock box, is already noted in the thread. A depth bias on the overlay would fix it later. It would also be worth opening an issue for it.
- The teal overlay hides while the traced whole-program stock view is active. This is documented as a known limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 1ab3fc880d9bdebeecc0f599b142203120e2d0dc -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: it merges at the next cut). One non-blocking doc fix is listed below.

Reviewed at head 1ab3fc88, trial-merged with current `upstream/main` (60aa217e): the merge is clean, no conflicts. The PR touches no `build.rs`, `.github/`, scripts, `Cargo` files or `CHANGELOG.md`, and adds no dependencies.

**What looks good**
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in the new code. `incoming_shape` skips a bad sheet index (`setup_stock_view.rs:64-70`). `floor_and_walls` uses `checked_add_signed` and bounds checks (`setup_stock_shell.rs:41-43`) and drops non-finite or inverted spans (`:20-24`). An empty body or sheet is refused by name.
- Layering holds: ui reads only `camcraft_app::setup_stock_view` and `setup_stock`. No components were added outside `schema.rs`.
- View state, not a command: the overlay follows the open page and is ephemeral, as the AGENTS.md exemption allows. The cache is keyed by (setup, active setup, `doc_version`), measured once per version and cleared when the page closes (`incoming_view.rs`).
- The page's box/volume now reuses the viewport's measurement, so one program sim runs per version, not two.
- The closed block (floor plus walls) and the traced-stock overlay draw fix address the two failures from the earlier hand checks. The latest GUI check on this head passed.
- Provenance lines are present on all three new modules. The decision file exists. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #406`. Commit subjects are conventional.

**Local results (merged with main, own fresh target dir)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `setup_stock_view` | 3 passed |
| app `setup_stock_source` | 6 passed |
| app `setup_carry` | 9 passed |
| ui lib (from `crates/ui`) | 443 passed, 5 ignored |
| all ui integration binaries (from `crates/ui`) | every binary ok, 0 failed (`gpu_render` 10 passed; this Mac has a GPU) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None blocking. Non-blocking, ideally fixed on this branch before the cut (which means turning the PR back into a draft first):
1. `docs/decisions/406-incoming-stock-preview.md` is stale against the final head. Its "Dropped" list says a closed outer shell was dropped ("the issue asks for the display sheet"), but `setup_stock_shell.rs` now closes the sheet into a block. Its "Known limit" says the traced stock hides the preview, but `viewport.rs` (`overlay_index_start`, around :875) now draws it after the traced stock. The file also says "sheet" throughout. The PR body repeats both points and still says "draft until the GUI check". Please update both so the ledger matches what shipped.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs` is 1472 lines, far over the ~400 law, and grew by about 45 net. `draw_order` and `is_overlay` could move into a small sibling module in a later split.
- `floor_and_walls` is pinned only at the app level (`the_incoming_stock_is_a_closed_block`, which checks the Z span). Nothing checks triangle winding or outward normals; a unit test on a tiny body would pin it.
- Z-fighting between the teal top and the setup's own Stock top, noted in the earlier hand check, is a known cosmetic limit.
- Snapshot goldens are unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
